description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_Php class, a plugin resource for Smarty templates that handles PHP template files, including loading content, populating compiled file paths, and rendering templates uncompiled.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Php
classes.description: A Smarty internal plugin resource class for handling PHP template files, supporting uncompiled templates, and rendering PHP templates directly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource, storing the current state of the short_open_tag directive.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template source content from the file system, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the compiled template object with filepath, timestamp, and dependencies based on the source template.

methods.name: renderUncompiled
methods.description: Renders the PHP template directly without compilation, handling PHP template enabling and error conditions.
